steps.label: Parse remap config
steps.description: Parse the interaction-type remap option into a lookup map.

steps.label: CSV parse
steps.description: Parse the raw Chronicle CSV text into header-keyed rows (throws on parse errors).

steps.label: Drop empty timestamps
steps.description: Drop raw rows with no event timestamp — unusable by every downstream step.

steps.label: Detect device model
steps.description: Classify the stream as Amazon Fire vs Android from package-name evidence.

steps.label: Resolve run datetime
steps.description: Resolve the datetime-of-preprocessing stamp (runtime-pinned for reproducibility).

steps.label: Build canonical rows
steps.description: Build typed canonical rows: normalize strings, remap interaction types, parse ns timestamps, stamp calendar columns.

steps.label: Stable sort
steps.description: Sort rows by event timestamp, ties broken by original row index.

steps.label: Collect timezones
steps.description: Collect the distinct, sorted timezones present in the file (drives the timezone picker).

steps.label: Dominant timezone
steps.description: Find the most frequent timezone across the rows (the primary clock).

steps.label: Select strategy
steps.description: Pick the target timezone and (for filter strategies) the surviving rows, per the timezone-handling setting.

steps.label: Restamp rows
steps.description: Restamp every surviving row onto the target timezone and recompute its calendar columns.

steps.label: Row-count report
steps.description: Before/after/removed row counts for the timezone step's report.

steps.label: Exact dedupe
steps.description: Collapse exact-duplicate raw rows (same participant, timestamp, app, interaction type), keeping the first. Gated by deduplicateExactRows.

steps.label: Count duplicate groups
steps.description: Count same-timestamp event groups before correction, for the run report.

steps.label: Nudge duplicate timestamps
steps.description: Nudge same-timestamp events apart (resume-first priority order) so event ordering is deterministic. Gated by correctDuplicateEventTimestamps.

steps.label: Mark data-time gaps
steps.description: Stamp each row with the gap (hours) since the previous event in the stream.

steps.label: Tag filtered packages
steps.description: TAGGING ONLY: relabel filter-listed packages' raw events 'Filtered App *' so the list is visible downstream. Nothing is dropped or blanked here.

steps.label: Collect keyguard timestamps
steps.description: Sorted timestamps of every keyguard-shown event — the lock-screen evidence stream.

steps.label: Walk screen state machine
steps.description: CLOSED —screen-start→ OPEN —screen-stop→ CLOSED, accumulating keyguard/unlock/foreground evidence; emits one close per session.

steps.label: Build & classify sessions
steps.description: Materialize each close as a 'Screen Usage' row and classify its end reason (manual/auto lock, kept-awake, lock-screen-only, …) with a confidence.

steps.label: Compute junk packages
steps.description: The junk (filter-listed) package set: packages carrying any Filtered-* event. Empty when the filter file is off.

steps.label: Junk-blind fold
steps.description: Fold pre-relabeled junk events back to their Activity equivalents so the matcher sees every app identically (junk-BLIND matching).

steps.label: Build matcher input
steps.description: Factorize app codes and build the resumed/stop/background masks the matcher consumes (throws when the file has no app events).

steps.label: Run matcher
steps.description: Pair resumes with stops (WASM matcher; JS matcher when the proximity glue is on).

steps.label: Apply matcher output
steps.description: Stamp episode start/stop timestamps from the matcher pairings; mark unmatched resumes 'End of Usage Missing'.

steps.label: Relabel usage + floor
steps.description: Drop pauses/unmatched resumes, relabel matched resumes as usage episodes, and apply the minimum-duration floor.

steps.label: Junk downstream mark
steps.description: The ONE lossy filter decision, after matching: relabel junk apps' own episodes 'Filtered App Usage' (background junk keeps real timing).

steps.label: Sort episodes
steps.description: Re-sort rows by event timestamp after the relabels.

steps.label: Split concurrent sessions
steps.description: Phase 2 (concurrent modeling / background apps only): layer overlapping sessions into primary/secondary sub-intervals.

steps.label: Codebook join
steps.description: Join each episode's package against the app codebook: null-fill output columns, copy matched records through the rename map, stamp Unknown sentinels.

steps.label: Derive broad category
steps.description: Coalesce the per-source category columns onto the palette vocabulary (desktop order) for every row with a codebook record.

steps.label: Collapse genre ids
steps.description: Reconcile per-source genre ids: agreement promotes the genre, disagreement yields null, none yields Unknown.

steps.label: Engagement walk
steps.description: Sequential walk over foreground episodes computing new-engagement (30 s / custom), app switches, and inter-episode gaps — any-app and valid-app variants.

steps.label: Flag & retain
steps.description: Stamp quality flags for long usage sessions and long data gaps — flag, never drop.

steps.label: Blank junk timing
steps.description: The SOLE blanking site: null start/stop/duration on 'Filtered App Usage' rows, after the engagement walk has read their real timing.

steps.label: Drop selected types
steps.description: Drop the event types selected for removal — kept when they witness a large data gap.

steps.label: Drop zero-duration
steps.description: Optionally drop zero-duration usage episodes (null-duration rows are kept). Gated by filterZeroDurationSessions.

steps.label: Partition sessions
steps.description: Split the cleaned rows into credit-eligible App-Usage sessions (positive duration) vs pass-through rest.

steps.label: Build liveness substrate
steps.description: Per participant: screen ON/OFF change points, boot timestamps, all event timestamps, and screen-capability — from the RAW event stream.

steps.label: Report screen-incapable
steps.description: Participants whose stream carries no usable screen change points.

steps.label: Count day apps
steps.description: Distinct apps per (participant, date) — the no-witness fallback gate.

steps.label: Credit sessions
steps.description: Per session: cap the end, intersect device-alive with screen-creditable intervals (auto-lock bridging), apply the no-witness fallback.

steps.label: Emit credited rows
steps.description: Rewrite each session into one clone row per credited interval, recomputing duration and calendar columns.

steps.label: Assemble credit result
steps.description: Credited rows first, then the pass-through rest, plus the credit report.

steps.label: Resolve participant windows
steps.description: Resolve each participant to their study window (exact id, then numerical id) from the study-dates file.

steps.label: Filter rows to window
steps.description: Keep rows whose local date falls inside the participant's [start, end] window; participants without a window are kept whole and reported.

steps.label: Resolve sharing status
steps.description: Resolve every participant to Shared / Non-Shared from the device-sharing file (throws on gaps — never defaults).

steps.label: Build survey lookup
steps.description: (participant, exact event timestamp) → user map from survey answers; later rows win.

steps.label: Attribute rows
steps.description: Fill null usernames (kids-shell → Target Child), apply survey relabels, re-mark non-target App Usage on shared devices.

steps.label: Inject placeholders
steps.description: Inject one zero-duration 'No Activity' placeholder per participant-day that has raw events but no usage. Gated by addNoActivityPlaceholderDays.

steps.label: Build raw date index
steps.description: Per-participant set of raw event dates — the 'device was alive' evidence.

steps.label: Build coverage table
steps.description: Classify every spine day usage / no_activity / no_data (hard invariant: a data day the spine misses is an error). Gated by enableDayCoverage.

steps.label: Accumulate attribution minutes
steps.description: Bucket known vs unknown attributed minutes per (participant, day) using the attribution SSOT.

steps.label: Score days
steps.description: known/(known+unknown)×100 per shared-device day vs the threshold; Non-Shared days are 100; zero-usage days flagged.

steps.label: Assemble result
steps.description: Assemble everything the run produced — app rows, screen sessions, credited usage, window/attribution/coverage/compliance reports — into the downloadable result set.
